scope: Working-tree changes since the delivered base: bounded PNG qualification, six new skills and eight contract enhancements, deterministic help and profiles, Chat/PowerShell onboarding, reusable demo scheduling, and directly associated tests and generated evidence.

resolvedFindings.issue: The generated graph declared success while omitting every prerequisite edge.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Rebuilt from the native validated inventory, checked cycles, ownership, and profile closure, and added a regression requiring exact equality with all contract declarations.
resolvedFindings.result: 56 skills and 136 verified prerequisite edges; the regression failed before regeneration and passed afterward.

validation.postGateChanges: Generated evidence refresh and repository-defined whitespace normalization only.

evidence: Reviewed the shared PNG decoder, both image adapters, final artifact verifier, independent fixtures, and malformed-input regressions.
Reviewed skill contracts, profile membership, generated help, and exact dependency evidence.
Reviewed separate Chat/PowerShell onboarding, purpose/no-purpose examples, optional live scheduling, and the presenter-notes update.
The full npm run check gate passed, including security checks, unsigned candidate verification, 953 tests, inventory, and framework verification.
The approved credential-free origin is QuyDu/Project-Orchestrator; the existing release/1.1.2 upstream matched the local base and was not protected at inspection.
limitations: This is a bounded source-change review, not a fresh repository-wide or live-provider audit.
The pre-existing lightweight security-check source digest includes its transient release lock. Stable final-input verification uses the cached Gitleaks certificate and native scanInputDigest instead.
Three platform-dependent test skips remain explicit; hosted, tenant, device, and live image-provider qualification were not performed.
The formal release remains blocked by signing, independent release review, and operational evidence.
Approval covers a normal commit and push to the existing upstream only; no force push, default-branch merge, tag, package publication, or deployment.
The delivery checkpoint precedes commit creation. Actual commit and remote delivery must be verified from Git rather than inferred from this report.
